guard_pose: wide stance facing right in spiked red-and-black dragon-scale armour, gripping an enormous greatsword with both hands at the hip, the long blade angled up and forward

jab: blade shove: shoves the enormous greatsword forward with both hands, the flat of the blade leading at chest height, then pulls it back into the stance
jab2: wide slash: swings the enormous greatsword with both hands from high in front down and across in front of him in one heavy diagonal cut, then heaves it back into the stance
ftilt: overhead slash: lifts the enormous greatsword above his head with both hands and brings it straight down to low in front of him, then heaves it back into the stance
utilt: rising slash: sweeps the enormous greatsword with both hands from in front of him up over his head to behind him, then back into the stance
dtilt: crouching low cut: drops into a crouch and sweeps the enormous greatsword with both hands low in front at shin height, then rises back into the stance
dashattack: running slash: lunges forward with a long heavy stride and swings the enormous greatsword across in a wide horizontal cut, then stops and settles back into the stance
fsmash: charged smash: raises the enormous greatsword with both hands far behind his head, the blade flashing red with charge, then brings it down in a tremendous cut to the front, then recovers into the stance
usmash: rising smash: crouches, then swings the enormous greatsword with both hands in a big arc from in front straight up over his head, the blade flashing red with charge, then back into the stance
dsmash: low spinning cut: slashes the enormous greatsword with both hands low in front, then spins around and slashes low behind him, the blade flashing red with charge, then back into the stance
nair: spinning double cut in mid-air: chops the enormous greatsword down in front of him, then swings it back up, the weapon making a full circle around his body, then back to the tucked pose
fair: crescent cut in mid-air: swings the enormous greatsword in a big arc from above his head down to below him in front, then back to the tucked pose
bair: backward cut in mid-air: twists his torso and swings the enormous greatsword behind him in a downward arc, then back to the tucked pose
uair: overhead arc in mid-air: swings the enormous greatsword from behind him over his head to the front, then back to the tucked pose
dair: downward stab in mid-air: points the enormous greatsword straight down beneath him and plunges it down, then pulls it back up to the tucked pose
ledgeattack: rises from a low crouch with a quick low horizontal cut of the enormous greatsword forward at knee height, then back into the stance
getupattack: from lying on his back, swings the enormous greatsword low across in front of him, then behind him while springing to his feet, ending in the stance

nspecial: Charged Slash: hoists the enormous greatsword back over his shoulder with both hands and holds it there, trembling, as the blade flashes red with charge, then brings it crashing down in a tremendous vertical cut to the front, the blade stopping low in front of him, then heaves it back into the stance
sspecial: tackle: braces the enormous greatsword flat against his side and rams forward shoulder first, then slows to a stop and returns to the stance
uspecial: Clutch Claw: aims his free forearm straight up and fires the grappling claw of the slinger on his wrist on a short cable, then is yanked straight up after it, the greatsword hanging in his other hand, ending high in mid-air with the arm raised
dspecial: Large Barrel Bomb: kneels on one knee, sets a big red barrel bomb down just in front of him with his free hand and gives it a push forward, then stands back up into the stance
ultimate: True Charged Slash: rams forward shoulder first in a tackle with the enormous greatsword braced at his side, then swings two heavy charged slashes, the blade flashing, then hoists it high over his shoulder as it flashes bright red, holds the charge, and brings it down in one devastating vertical cut to the front, then heaves it back into the stance
w0_nspecial: Elemental Discharge: holding a Charge Blade in axe mode, a huge axe with a broad shield-like head and glowing yellow phials, he raises it overhead with both hands and slams it down in front of him, the phials bursting in a blast of crackling yellow energy at the blade, then lifts it back into the stance
w0_ultimate: Amped Elemental Discharge: holding a Charge Blade in axe mode, its phials glowing bright yellow, he swings it up in a full arc over his head, then slams it down in front of him in a huge vertical cut, a chain of crackling yellow phial explosions bursts out in front of the blade, then one final big yellow blast, then he lifts the axe and returns to the stance
w1_nspecial: shelling: holding a heavy gunlance, a long thick lance with a shell chamber, he braces and thrusts it forward, a fiery shell blast explodes from the muzzle at its tip with a kick of recoil, then pulls it back into the stance
w1_ultimate: Wyvern's Fire: holding a heavy gunlance, he plants his feet and aims it straight forward, steam hisses from vents as the barrel glows orange-red and the gunlance shakes while it charges, then a massive burst of fire roars out of the muzzle and the recoil jolts his whole body backward, he holds firm, then the flames die down, smoke curls from the barrel and he returns to the stance

walk: walks forward to the right in side profile, still gripping the enormous greatsword with both hands, the blade angled up and forward: the back leg steps past the front leg, then the other, the body and head stay turned to the right the whole time exactly like the first frame, a seamless two-step walk cycle that ends exactly on the first pose
crouch: squats down very low on the spot: knees fully bent, hips dropped almost to the heels, back bent forward, still gripping the enormous greatsword with both hands, the blade angled up and forward
shield: braces to block: holds the broad flat of the enormous greatsword in front of his body as a shield and crouches slightly, a defensive guard
